scope: Reduce authoritative click-to-motion latency without changing backend, event order, shaders, artwork or required source readiness.

source_context.changes: This commit; runtime source frozen before final native run.
source_context.backend: Existing user working checkout, no backend edits in this task.
source_context.runtime: Native Windows Godot4.7.2 Forward+, serialized tests, no other Godot preview during live runs; no server CPU/nested profiling.

changes: Journal transactions copy mutable containers and share installed immutable leaves; public reducers remain detached.
Event actor captures protect mutable shells; sparse sensory sets and changed object-contact winners avoid exhaustive repeated work.
SSE reuses framing UTF8 admission while retaining the strict JSON/schema boundary; unconstrained wrappers do not traverse children again.
Complete admitted movement submits directly; compound/extra-position and hover paths retain Preview.
Required media metadata publishes before optional family estimates; exact terrain source closure depends on authored base material.
Completed required images publish within2ms/max8 per frame; completed optional jobs release decoder slots, with at most1 optional publication per frame.

cold_queue_regression_caught.cause: Unfinished required job selected ahead of completed optional jobs occupied three decoder slots; required work effectively serialized.
cold_queue_regression_caught.fix: Collect completed required first, otherwise completed optional when allowed, refill freed slots immediately. Held-worker fixture verifies readiness still waits for every required source.

remaining_limits: No universal FPS claim. Worst command-window frame remains112.396ms during the large Gallery reveal (baseline143.204ms).
Cold character media still requires uploads at the16GiB combined soft cache cap: command48 first motion413.379ms versus638.876ms baseline. The full required source gate is preserved.
An active optional metadata task cannot be preempted; required requests take precedence at the next task boundary.
An individual texture upload can exceed the2ms slice. GPU asset quality, renderer settings and cache cap are unchanged.
Matched-route timings are single live runs with ordinary runtime variance; packet shapes agree, but wire UUIDs/bytes are not identical. Paired identical-operation evidence is separately recorded.
Existing strict event admission and canonical sensory folding still contribute latency; this does not claim those costs are eliminated.
